about: The single learning track: stages in order, modules in order inside each stage. Topic order inside a module comes from that module's _module.md 'Suggested order'. Tiers and role paths in taxonomy.json are kept as metadata.

stages.title: Programming foundations

stages.title: Building LLM applications
stages.blurb: Prompting, retrieval, multimodal inputs and agents that use tools reliably.

stages.title: Quality and production
stages.blurb: Evaluating, serving, observing and securing AI systems in production.

stages.title: Architecture

stages.title: Customer delivery
